description: Manual Phase 3 extraction of SGO Report IDs named in published NHTSA ODI investigation resumes for Tesla FSD reduced-visibility crashes. These IDs are used only to ask whether SGO-Audit consistency flags overlap with records NHTSA has already named/scrutinized.
responsible_use: These report IDs are not automation-level misclassification ground truth. Flags are review signals only, not findings of misclassification, fault, or comparative safety performance.

investigations.notes: Engineering Analysis opened for FSD collisions in reduced roadway visibility conditions. The resume names six recent potentially related SGO Report IDs and seven failure-report-summary SGO Report IDs. The six recent IDs are not expected in the current Archive-2021-2025 snapshot.
